status: In Oct 2025 the CMO said there would be a token and an airdrop. At TOKEN2049 (7 Oct 2026) the CEO said they are building a usable on-chain asset, but there is no name or date yet.
tasks: First check it works from Thailand; if blocked, skip it. Do not use a VPN.
Create a separate farming wallet and sign up with it
Deposit $20–50 USDC on Polygon
Trade markets in several categories, at least once a week
Hold some positions until the market resolves
Try placing limit orders to provide liquidity
Follow the official X @Polymarket
warn: Prediction bets can lose your stake and may count as gambling under Thai law

status: The team said in Sep 2025 it was exploring a token; in May 2026 code for a token system appeared, but as of Oct 2026 there is no token announcement, date or criteria.
tasks: Install Base App or Coinbase Wallet (a separate wallet)
Send $20–50 of ETH or USDC to Base
Register a Basename (.base.eth)
Swap on Aerodrome or Uniswap
Deposit or lend a little on Morpho or Aave on Base
Mint an NFT or post on Zora 1–2 times
Keep using it 2–3 times a month

status: Ink Foundation announced the INK token and an airdrop weighted toward real usage, but no distribution date as of 22 Oct 2026.
tasks: Check you can open a Kraken account from Thailand, then do KYC
Check the Ink Points page in the Kraken app
Trade on Kraken Pro as usual
Use Kraken Wallet to send a little to the Ink chain
Use apps on Ink 2–3 times
Follow the official X @inkonchain
warn: Fake INK claim sites exist, e.g. ink-airdrop.vercel.app. Claim only through the Kraken app.
